title: Iain McGilchrist
idiom: Haeckel-style naturalist engraving — fine pen-and-ink, divided into two attentional registers, no CGI
hero_prompt: A wide naturalist pen-and-ink engraving in the tradition of Ernst Haeckel, one continuous world crossed by a faint central seam (joined, not split): on the left a bird's head bends in tight, precise, narrowly-focused crosshatch onto a single small seed; on the right the SAME landscape opens broad and whole — rolling hills, vast sky, a far horizon — in looser, airier, open linework held all at once. The two are the same scene attended two ways. White ink line on very dark ground, cross-hatched, scientific-plate texture. No letters, numerals, words, labels, inscriptions — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: Bold high-contrast emblem on near-black ground: a single stylized bird's eye and beak, the left half rendered in tight precise engraved line, the right half opening into one bold broad sweep — two modes of attention in one mark. Heavy contrast, no fine linework that vanishes small, survives at 24px. No letters, numerals, words, labels, inscriptions — purely pictorial.
